correctness.rationale: Stable positive-coefficient two-box ODE gives unique periodic solution. Explicit complex inverse transfer yields strictly positive X,Y on an open semicircle. Direct symbolic differentiation produces a positive denominator times the increasing exchange-quadratic, negative at zero, proving a unique strict minimum and all boundary counts. Phase inversion quadratic confirms exact twin identities; Möbius injectivity proves differing amplitudes. On any closed positive exchange interval, the derivative polynomial switches sign in the interior iff Ω(a)<ω<Ω(b), with strict monotonicity at equality. Replayed independent exact rational code yielded 149742 assertions. This is an infinite analytic proof with finite checks only supplementary.

originality.rationale: Full primary transfer function and Bode plot are explicitly credited as known. Identified additional parameter-direction theorem: exact transfer locus as exchange varies, one interior phase fold, complete positive parameter phase preimage counts, and a strict bounded-interval forcing-frequency design boundary. The inspected most relevant model, transfer and likelihood-calibration papers do not state this result. Public mathematics-record searches found adjacent phase/eigenvalue claims but no statement implying it. Historic RC-network equivalent coverage cannot be ruled out without deeper inspection.
residual_risks: A pre-2010 or later equivalent two-node thermal RC-network/electrical impedance circle derivation could subsume the exact fold; this was not exhaustively inspected.

value.rationale: Climate energy-balance models use ocean-heat exchange for transient response and calibration; the theorem identifies a natural nonidentifiability of phase-only forcing experiments even with remaining coefficients known. It completely characterizes the ambiguity, its sharp forcing-frequency entry and exit boundaries for any physically justified κ interval, and a specific additional amplitude observable that eliminates it. This is structural inverse-problem information, not a tautological parameter substitution or an unsupported empirical application.
